title: GLM-5.2 – How to Run Locally
summary: A technical guide on running GLM-5.2, a large language model, locally using Unsloth's optimization framework, which provides faster inference and reduced memory consumption compared to standard implementations.
problem_solved: Enables efficient local deployment of the GLM-5.2 LLM with optimized memory usage and faster inference speeds on consumer hardware.
why_valuable: Makes running powerful open-source LLMs accessible to developers with limited GPU resources by providing significant performance optimizations and easy-to-follow local setup instructions.
